verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Gemini CLI can automate git-adjacent operations like handling complex rebases and querying pull requests (via natural language or @github integration), and its GitHub Action can do automated PR reviews and issue triage, implying some git/PR workflow capability. However, there is no explicit evidence it stages changes, writes commit messages, creates branches, or opens new pull requests itself. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or examples of staging/commit/branch creation, PR opening (vs. just querying/reviewing existing PRs), and hands-on confirmation of these specific actions.
